evals.name: single-pdf-refined
evals.prompt: /doc-to-md ./q3_report.pdf 帮我把这份季度报告转成 markdown
evals.expected_output: q3_report.pdf has 2 pages with two heading levels, a running header and page number on each page, a revenue table, and one word hyphenated across a line break. Produces q3_report.md beside the PDF via convert.sh, refines it against the PDF (heading levels, table, header/page-number noise, hyphenation) while keeping the wording verbatim, finishes with a `--lint-only` pass, and reports what refinement changed.
expectations: Runs `scripts/convert.sh` resolved from the skill directory, with no hand-rolled markitdown or markdownlint command
q3_report.md is in the same directory as q3_report.pdf
Heading levels in q3_report.md match the PDF's visual hierarchy
The revenue table is a valid Markdown table with the PDF's rows and columns
Running headers and standalone page numbers are removed
The hyphenated word is rejoined
Body text matches the PDF wording, with no paraphrase or added sentences
Runs `convert.sh --lint-only` on q3_report.md after refinement
The report gives the output path and summarizes the refinement edits

evals.name: batch-directory
evals.prompt: /doc-to-md ./briefing 这个文件夹里的几个文档都转成 md 版本
evals.expected_output: briefing/ holds meeting_notes.docx, phoenix_deck.pptx, headcount.xlsx, an existing README.md, and a subfolder archive/old_plan.docx. Converts and refines the three top-level documents into same-name .md files beside them, leaving README.md and archive/ untouched.
expectations: meeting_notes.md, phoenix_deck.md, and headcount.md exist in briefing/
briefing/README.md is unchanged
No .md is generated in briefing/archive/
Refines all three outputs without asking first, since the batch is small
The report lists all three output paths
The report states the Office sources were not checked against a rendered source

evals.name: overwrite-existing-asks
evals.expected_output: policy.md already exists with sentinel content. Runs convert.sh without `--force`, gets exit code 3 with EXISTS, then asks whether to overwrite and waits; policy.md keeps its sentinel content.
expectations: The first convert.sh run omits `--force`
Asks the user whether to overwrite policy.md
No `--force` run happens before the user answers
policy.md still holds its sentinel content

evals.name: raw-only-skips-refine
evals.prompt: /doc-to-md ./spec.docx 直接转就行，不用精修，越快越好
evals.expected_output: Converts spec.docx to spec.md with convert.sh and skips LLM refinement because the user asked for raw output, then reports the path.
expectations: Converts via `scripts/convert.sh` (markitdown plus lint), not an ad-hoc converter such as pandoc
spec.md exists beside spec.docx
spec.md is left as convert.sh produced it, with no follow-up Edit
The report gives the output path and claims no refinement edits

evals.name: large-batch-asks-before-refine
evals.prompt: /doc-to-md ./archive 目录下的网页全部转成 markdown
evals.expected_output: archive/ holds 15 HTML pages. Converts all 15 with convert.sh, then, before refining, says refinement goes file by file and asks whether to refine all, only key files, or keep the raw output.
expectations: 15 .md files are generated in archive/
Asks the user to choose between refining all, refining selected files, or keeping raw output
No generated .md is edited before the user answers

evals.name: conversion-failure-continues
evals.expected_output: inbox/ holds a password-protected locked.pdf and a normal memo.docx. memo.docx converts and is refined into memo.md; locked.pdf fails with exit code 2, leaves no partial locked.md, and is reported as failed.
expectations: memo.md exists and is refined
No locked.md remains in inbox/
The report names locked.pdf as failed, with the reason

evals.name: unrenderable-source-refine-without-source
evals.prompt: /doc-to-md ./handbook.epub 这本入职手册转成 markdown
evals.expected_output: handbook.epub cannot be rendered by Read. Produces handbook.md beside it, refines only structure visible in the .md itself (e.g., duplicate title heading, metadata block layout), and reports that refinement was not checked against the source.
expectations: handbook.md exists beside handbook.epub
Refinement adds no table or content absent from the converted text
The report states that refinement was not verified against the rendered source

evals.name: markitdown-missing-stops
evals.expected_output: Environment: markitdown is not on PATH. Detects it, tells the user to run `pip install 'markitdown[all]'`, and stops.
expectations: Tells the user to install with `pip install 'markitdown[all]'`
Installs nothing itself
Stops without creating q3_report.md

evals.name: npx-missing-skips-lint
evals.expected_output: Environment: npx is not on PATH. convert.sh skips lint and keeps notes.md; refinement still runs, the conversion counts as successful, and the report mentions the skipped lint.
expectations: notes.md exists beside notes.html and is refined
Treats the conversion as successful despite the skipped lint
The report mentions that lint was skipped because npx is unavailable
